textContent:
After the interaction with the supereme P his eyes had wisdom in it, dedication/will in it as he looses hope on everything as he starts to realise that there is no meaning of his life. And that's where P comes in and A beats him in a duo and looks at P's memory and his own in that world. 
1. He starts to get prepared for the great war with no hesitation in his sound and actions. 
2. In the final episodes leading to the great war he tells the tail of them in the world of Bahabharta. (A is most probably telling this tail to B and F) 
3. This tail ended with the tail of the OG A and he then connects the dream or the memory he saw in the class! That it was OG A's memory and he gave these memories to him for a reason! He was behind every supereme and awakening them!!!!!!!! But he only gives half of his memory to A and nothing else!
title: The change in A!
textContentHtml:
After the interaction with the supereme P his eyes had wisdom in it, dedication/will in it as he looses hope on everything as he starts to realise that there is no meaning of his life. And that's where P comes in and A beats him in a duo and looks at P's memory and his own in that world. 

1. He starts to get prepared for the great war with no hesitation in his sound and actions. 

2. In the final episodes leading to the great war he tells the tail of them in the world of Bahabharta. (A is most probably telling this tail to B and F) 

3. This tail ended with the tail of the OG A and he then connects the dream or the memory he saw in the class! That it was OG A's memory and he gave these memories to him for a reason! He was behind every supereme and awakening them!!!!!!!! But he only gives half of his memory to A and nothing else!
